cases.sentence: Он вошел в дом Божий, взял ___ и ел, и своим спутникам дал, несмотря на то что его нельзя есть никому, кроме священников .
cases.explain: «священный хлеб» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”

cases.explain: «правой рукой» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

cases.sentence: Но Иисус знал, о чем они думали, и сказал человеку с ___:
cases.explain: «иссохшей рукой» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up, and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.

cases.sentence: Там уже собралась ___ Его учеников и великое множество народа со всей Иудеи, Иерусалима и прибрежных областей Тира и Сидона.
cases.explain: «большая толпа» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: He came down with them, and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples, and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases;

cases.sentence: Там уже собралась большая толпа Его учеников и великое множество народа со всей Иудеи, Иерусалима и ___ Тира и Сидона.
cases.explain: «прибрежных областей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He came down with them, and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples, and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases;

cases.sentence: ___, утрясенной и пересыпающейся через край, вам отсыплют в вашу полу.
cases.explain: «Полной мерой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”

cases.sentence: Лицемер, вынь сначала бревно из ___, а потом ты увидишь, как вынуть соринку из глаза своего брата.
cases.explain: «собственного глаза» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.

cases.sentence: ___ не приносит плохих плодов, и плохое дерево не приносит хороших, 44 так что каждое дерево узнают по его плодам.
cases.explain: «Хорошее дерево» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit; nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.

cases.sentence: Из хранилища добра в своем сердце ___ выносит доброе, а злой человек выносит злое из своего хранилища зла.
cases.explain: «добрый человек» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.
